A small quest from the {wiki:Tibia Tales} in Edron: {npc:Spectulus} and {npc:Sinclair} want to study ghosts. You measure the energy of graves in the Edron cemetery with a magical device and then capture the essence of a {creature:Ghost} in a spirit cage. You earn 2 × 500 experience points and the achievement **Guinea Pig**, and unlock the {wiki:Spirithunters Quest}.
Spectulus and Sinclair need help with an investigation into ghosts.
After handing the full cage to {npc:Sinclair}: talk to him again to start.
Each use of the device on a grave makes a {creature:Squidgy Slime} appear: be ready to kill it.
In mission 2, use the cage on the Ghost's body **right after** killing it.

Take a boat to **Edron** (you arrive at the port of {npc:Captain Seahorse}, who also takes you back) and go to the {wiki:Ivory Towers}, the seven ivory towers in the **east** part of the city. Climb to the top of the central (tallest) tower and talk to {npc:Spectulus}. Say {key:hi}, {key:tasks}, {key:research} and answer the questions: {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:no}, {key:yes}. Then say {key:research} and {key:yes} again. He gives you the {item:Magical Measurement Device} (the *spirit meter*).

Go to the {wiki:Edron Graveyard|Edron graveyard} and use the {item:Magical Measurement Device} on **four** graves. Every time you use it a {creature:Squidgy Slime} appears: kill it. The graveyard is on the surface, **north** of the city: afterwards walk back the same way to the Ivory Towers and climb to the central tower again.
Tell {npc:Spectulus} {key:task} and {key:research}. He asks you to fetch the spirit cage from {npc:Sinclair}.
Talk to {npc:Sinclair} (also in the Ivory Towers). Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He gives you the {item:Spirit Cage}.
Find a {creature:Ghost}, kill it and **right after** use the {item:Spirit Cage} on its remains to capture the essence.
Go back to {npc:Sinclair} with the full cage and hand it over (say {key:hi} and {key:mission}).

Talk to {npc:Sinclair} again: the {wiki:Spirithunters Quest} begins, in which you have to capture 5 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, 5 {creature:Nightstalker|Nightstalkers} and 5 {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}.
